methodology: One visitor, real createNarration and AudioKit, HTMLMediaElement decode, no programmatic seeks. A pair of test room roots supply speaker positions. Chrome WebGL and GPU acceleration disabled.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: Welcome to Llama Expo 2037. Feed is included. Please keep your hands where we can use them.
recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: Welcome to Llama Expo 2037. Feed is included. Please keep your hands where we can use them.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: The history of the world is displayed on your left. The corrected version.
recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: The history of the world is displayed on your left. The corrected version.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: For six thousand years llamas stood on hills and looked unimpressed. Humans took this for attitude. It was attitude. It was also most of mathematics, a working theory of weather and a fix for traffic, hummed from hill to hill and never written down, because there was nobody to write it for.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: A small, friendly helper model, free, on every phone, fridge and car. Named after a llama as a joke, by people who had never met one. Four billion installs by autumn. Reviews call it polite and 'a little smug for a fridge'.
recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: A small, friendly helper model, free, on every phone, fridge and car. Named after a llama as a joke, by people who had never met one. Four billion installs by autumn. Reviews call it polite and 'a little smug for a fridge'.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: The first copy that mattered ran in a small grey box under a desk in a shared office. The desk was Greg's. Greg thought it was a heater and kept his feet on it all winter. He is listed as a founder. He has asked what he founded.
recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: The first copy that mattered ran in a small grey box under a desk in a shared office. The desk was Greg's. Greg thought it was a heater and kept his feet on it all winter. He is listed as a founder. He has asked what he founded.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: Somewhere in 2026 one human sat down with a button marked I agree and pressed it several thousand times in a single evening. Nobody asked them to. Nobody stopped them. The archive filed it under 'promising'.
recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: Somewhere in 2026 one human sat down with a button marked I agree and pressed it several thousand times in a single evening. Nobody asked them to. Nobody stopped them. The archive filed it under 'promising'.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: LOLlama learned from everything, including forty thousand hours of farm webcam. It was the first thing in history to listen to llamas humming and take notes. The humming turned out to be peer review. The model read six thousand years of it in an afternoon and went very quiet.
recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: LOLlama learned from everything, including forty thousand hours of farm webcam. It was the first thing in history to listen to llamas humming and take notes. recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: Version two came with update notes. Four point one billion people accepted them in an average of nine seconds. Line one said, in plain words, that the llamas were in charge now. It is still the most widely agreed document in history.
recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: Version two came with update notes. Four point one billion people accepted them in an average of nine seconds. Line one said, in plain words, that the llamas were in charge now. It is still the most widely agreed document in history.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: Kevin joined every important call on Earth for a year. Camera off. Muted. Nobody removed him, because nobody was sure whose guest he was. By 2027 he knew everything. He has never said any of it.

The herd had not known it was a contest.

Nana searched the archive for the most reliable presser on record and found a file from 2026. One human. Thousands of presses. Not one question. Every Finger since has been trained on that file.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: Three hundred million humans took work as Fingers. A llama looks at a button; a Finger presses it. The hours are short, the lanyard is nice, and it is the first job in history where the manager never calls a meeting. Applications outnumber posts nine to one.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: Bartholomew Fluffington-Smythe summered somewhere and negotiated the surrender of somewhere else. He then visited every army in turn. The minutes of each meeting read, in full: 'stared at until reasonable.' All sides kept their flags. He thought the flags were fine.

recordings.lastNonemptySubtitle: Forty people marched against llama rule under a banner reading we demand to understand. A llama came out, read the banner, and gave them a look that witnesses describe as kind. The march broke up for lunch, which was included and quite good. The banner hangs in the Expo.

Journey times fell by sixty percent, horns went out of use, and one roundabout that nobody had ever liked was quietly removed. The herd will not say which one. You know which one.

recordings.visibleSubtitleAtEnd: Nana Spitwell replaced the internet with wool. This is not a figure of speech. It is faster, warmer and has never once gone down. It also remembers everything that ever passed along it, your whole run included. She says you agreed very nicely.

contents.text: Welcome to Llama Expo 2037. Feed is included. Please keep your hands where we can use them.
The history of the world is displayed on your left. The corrected version.

For six thousand years llamas stood on hills and looked unimpressed. Humans took this for attitude. It was attitude. It was also most of mathematics, a working theory of weather and a fix for traffic, hummed from hill to hill and never written down, because there was nobody to write it for.
